reviews.review:
Probably my favorite game. Did 100% twice (including one with all weapons maxed) and I still like to boot it every now and then, help a few peeps with harder maps. Essentially its the experience of being a random soldier caught in global war, and slowly becoming the ultimate soldier as you gear up and learn both maps & what weapon to use against which enemy / in what situations.

A few maps can be extremely long / punishing , but practicing and learning how to use efficiently each weapons makes the slow grind & losses not so bad. 

My only two complaints are : 
- The lack of an option to get all the loot once you finish a map (which is easy to fix if you google for it, but results in too many people tempted to use other cheats).
- The game telling you ranger is your beginner class, which isn't true if you start from the getgo playing in hard mode. It has its perks, but the lack of mobility makes learning harder as your firepower isn't up to par yet 

PS : You can join DLC lobbies online even if you don't own them. Buying the DLC only gives you the ability to host such lobbies, and to loot Inferno (max difficulty) DLC weapons.

EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5 is a blast for fans of explosive action and alien extermination. Its over-the-top gameplay, massive battles, and diverse arsenal of weapons provide an exhilarating and addictive experience. While the visuals and mission variety could be improved, the game's core gameplay loop is undeniably fun and engaging.

This game is the best Japanese Arcade style co-op shooter there is! I've played the originals and this one capitalises on all the best things previously, dropping the annoying things the US studios added to their versions and stays true to the original Japanese fun filled excitement. More weapons than ever, more missions than ever! Me and my guys Poet and Dr_Uranu been streaming together our play throughs of this, search our names on YouTube & Twitch. I highly recommend this as a CO-OP game with friends and family. Can even do remote-play split screen as long as those joinging have controllers to play from their computers.
